modules.module_title: Carry out hand block printing of samples as per the given specifications

pcs.pc_description: ensure that the fabric is pinned appropriately on the printing table
mark the layout, if required
dip the block in the printing paste on the tray appropriately
stamp the block on the marked area/ position/ appropriate position
test the colour on waste cloth and judge if the colour is appropriate

print the filling blocks appropriately on the registered outline, if required
appropriately place succeeding block impressions as per design layout
ensure that the fabric is dried appropriately
ensure that the print is even

modules.module_title: Contribute to achieving the quality in hand block printing and related operations

pcs.pc_description: identify and use materials required based on the specifications provided
ensure that the fabric is pre-treated as per requirement
ensure that uniform tension is maintained while pinning the fabric on the printing table
ensure that the dye paste is mixed appropriately
ensure that the correct set of blocks are used for outline and filling prints
ensure appropriate registering of blocks
ensure proper handling of fabric while printing and post- printing to avoid transfer of colour to other areas
ensure that the shape/ size/ pattern/ design is not distorted while printing
ensure that there is no shade difference in the colours used
store the block printed fabric/ product appropriately
ensure uniformity in raw materials, design and techniquea. within a productb. between pair/ set of products
apply allowed tolerances
take the necessary action when materials do not conform to quality standards
maintain the required productivity and quality levels
report to the responsible person when the work flow of other production areas disrupts work
